en: Color postcard showing a picturesque view of a hillside covered in flowering trees and greenery with a large medieval-style clock tower on top. The tower has a steep red-tiled roof, wooden galleries on its sides, and huge clock faces on at least two sides. In the far background a church spire and dome are visible. Printed German text at the top right reads "Graz. – Uhrturm am Schlossberg."
